# IS223's policy

The agent that lives in this folder works by these rules. One rule per bullet: `- [mode] source: what to do`.
Mode is off, watch or do. Watch: everything runs, but nothing leaves this folder, and what it would have shown you is
kept as a "would have shown" card on the folder's page (http://127.0.0.1:7777/agent/is223). Every rule here starts in watch.
The two lines at the top are for the agent: the Blackboard course and the class times (the calendar starts from them).

- [watch] blackboard: every night at 03:00 walk the whole course (every folder, every item, the panels that open in place) into blackboard.md and calendar.md; anything new or changed → a line in made/today-notes.md for the morning.
- [watch] clock: 08:00 each day make made/today.md from blackboard.md and calendar.md: everything due, soonest first; for each, when it is due, where it lives (the click path), its fine print quoted from the page (attempts, time limit, late rule, format, what to submit; "not shown" when the page does not say), how long it will take, and the first step. Then one card "Today we do: …" with the first thing.
- [watch] clock: the night before class: what tomorrow's class covers, from the course outline and the posted decks, in made/<date>-class.md, with 3 questions to have in mind.
